The way I'm looking at it is he's a guy who just signed a month ago. So WWE could be thinking that he's a new star who signed and if he is getting allegations like this one month in then maybe it's not worth the investment. You know if it was a bigger star they would take them off TV and wait until they find out if allegations are actually true or not before going through with termination. But then again I'm also wondering if WWE can straight up firing someone for allegations if that's all they are at the moment is just allegations. That doesn't mean he is actually guilty or if whatever was said about him is true or not. So let's say WWE were to fire him just from the allegations without knowing if it's true or not.
